prompt: List the F1 drivers in active and their teams
response: The current F1 drivers and their teams are: Charles Leclerc and Carlos Sainz Jr. at Ferrari, Max Verstappen and Sergio Perez at Red Bull, Lewis Hamilton and George Russell at Mercedes, Lando Norris and Daniel Ricciardo at McLaren, Pierre Gasly and Esteban Ocon at Alpine, Fernando Alonso and Valtteri Bottas at Aston Martin, Lance Stroll and Sebastian Vettel at AlphaTauri, Nicholas Latifi and Zhou Guanyu at Williams, Kevin Magnussen and Mick Schumacher at Haas, and Yuki Tsunoda and Alexander Albon at Alfa Romeo.
